name: Rational Symmetric Invariant Disguise
description: Replaces the explicitly modular condition `(4*s_u + s_v) % 5 != 0` with a rational algebraic expression `(s_u^2 + s_v^2)/(s_u * s_v)` not being an integer. This algebraic expression is mathematically equivalent to `s_u != s_v` over the domain {1, 2, 3}, concealing the canonical 3-coloring constraint from pattern-matching models without changing the underlying logic.
